title: Kingfisher Lock
timingBasis: UTC clock readings from opening the game brief through completion of the JavaScript syntax check.
mobileSupportNotes: Browser check at 390 × 844 CSS pixels passed start, battery selection, platform placement and an upgrade using pointer clicks. The page fit the viewport without horizontal overflow. Physical touch hardware and a full round were not tested.

validation.syntax: Passed node --check on the inline classic JavaScript; independently rechecked by the parent.
validation.browser: Passed parent smoke test in the Codex browser through the local project preview at desktop and phone width, without console errors.
validation.interaction: At 390 × 844, start, placement and upgrade worked using pointer clicks. First wave and score progression were observed.
validation.render: Canvas defense map confirmed visually in desktop and phone-width screenshots.
